user.title: Add HASS.Agent device
user.description: PCs on MQTT are discovered automatically, and so are further PCs on the HA API once the integration has a device. Choose a manual connection method below.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Do you want to start set up?

local_api.title: HASS.Agent .NET10 Local HTTP API
local_api.description: This adds the device to HA using the local HTTP API. Only notifications are supported. Use MQTT or HA API for full functionality.

ha_api_info.title: Connect over the HA API
ha_api_info.description:
Make sure HASS.Agent .NET10 is running on the PC and set to use the **HA API** connection.

Then open the app, go to **Danger Zone** and press **Republish discovery** — or simply restart the app.

Press **Submit** here once you have done that, and the PC will be added.

error.no_discovery: No PC announced itself yet. Press **Republish discovery** in the Windows app (Danger Zone), then try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.no_devices_found: No devices found on the network.
abort.legacy_client: This PC runs the original HASS.Agent, which this integration does not support. Update the Windows client to HASS.Agent .NET10.

data.default_notification_title: Default notification title. Space to disable.

trigger_type.notifications_mqtt: When a notification with a specific action has been pressed (MQTT)
trigger_type.notifications_event: When a notification with a specific action has been pressed (Event)

confirm_restart.title: Restart required
confirm_restart.description: Device name has been changed, restart of Home Assistant is required to properly reload notify service for {name}, click submit to restart now.

legacy_client.title: {name} runs the old HASS.Agent
legacy_client.description:
**{name}** runs HASS.Agent {version}, the original Windows client. This integration is made for **HASS.Agent .NET10** and cannot talk to the old client, so this PC was not added. Nothing on the PC was changed.

Two ways forward:

- **Update the Windows client** to HASS.Agent .NET10 (recommended) — see **Learn more** below. Once it is updated, this notice disappears and the PC is discovered again.
- **Keep the old client for now** and go back to the last legacy release of this integration: in HACS open *HASS.Agent .NET10 Integration*, choose *Redownload* and pick version `v3.0.2`. That line still works with the old client, but it is no longer maintained.

If something goes wrong with the switch, the README and the issue tracker are linked from the project page under Learn more.

outdated_client.title: {name} needs a newer HASS.Agent .NET10
outdated_client.description: **{name}** runs HASS.Agent .NET10 {version}, but this integration needs **{minimum}** or newer. Some features will not work until the Windows client is updated — see **Learn more** below. This notice disappears once it is.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Shows a notification on the Windows PC, with an optional picture, buttons and text fields.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title. Without it the default title from the integration's options is used.

image.name: Picture
image.description: A camera or image entity (camera.front_door), a path on this Home Assistant (/local/doorbell.jpg), or a web address. Client 10.9.0+.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to five buttons. The action of the pressed one comes back in the Notification actions event.

inputs.name: Text fields
inputs.description: Up to five text fields. What was typed comes back with the pressed button, in input, by id. Client 10.9.0+.

style.name: Style
style.description: How this notification is shown. Without it the setting in the Windows client decides. Client 10.9.0+.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds on screen, 1 to 60. A Windows notification knows a short and a long length; above 10 the long one is used.

data.name: Data
data.description: The fields above as one object, the way they were given before they became fields of their own. A field given on its own wins.

execute_command.name: Run system command
execute_command.description: Runs a system command on the Windows PC (lock, sleep, shutdown and so on), or cancels a pending shutdown or restart.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: The Windows device, as named in the client.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command to run. It has to be enabled on the Capabilities page of the Windows client.

comment.name: Comment
comment.description: For shutdown and restart: the text Windows shows to the logged-in user.

force.name: Force
force.description: For shutdown and restart: do not wait for apps to close.

time.name: Delay
time.description: For shutdown and restart: seconds before it starts.

restart_cancel.name: Cancel shutdown or restart
restart_cancel.description: Cancels a pending shutdown or restart instead of running a command.

set_app_volume.name: Set app volume
set_app_volume.description: Sets the volume or mute of one app in the Windows volume mixer (client 10.9.0+, Audio sessions sensor enabled).

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: The Windows device, as named in the client.

app.name: App
app.description: The app as Task Manager names it, without .exe (e.g. spotify).
